title: Separating Interpretability and Reconstruction in Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.25165v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) are effective tools for mechanistic interpretability by decomposing neural representations into sparse and interpretable features. However, a single sparse representation in traditional SAEs is responsible for both reconstruction fidelity and interpretability, which are not guaranteed to align. To separate these objectives, we propose DualSAE, a modular framework that augments standard SAEs with a plug-in Residual Branch. A standard SAE serves as the Sparse Branch, learning a sparse code that contains the dominant semantics of the input. The added Residual Branch models the non-semantic information omitted by the Sparse Branch. We ensure that the contributions of the two branches towards the overall reconstruction have minimal overlap through a decorrelation loss. We also adopt a two-stage training strategy that first stabilizes sparse representation learning before coupling with the Residual Branch. Across div

translated_title: 在稀疏自编码器中分离可解释性与重构
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器通过将神经网络的内部表示分解为稀疏且可解释的特征，是机制可解释性研究的有效工具。然而，在传统SAE中，单一的稀疏表示同时承担着重构保真度与可解释性两个职责，而这两个目标并不保证相互一致。为了将这两个目标分离开来，我们提出了DualSAE，这是一个模块化框架，通过一个可插拔的残差分支来增强标准SAE。标准SAE充当稀疏分支，学习包含输入主要语义信息的稀疏编码；而新增的残差分支则负责对稀疏分支所忽略的非语义信息进行建模。我们通过一个去相关损失确保两个分支对整体重构的贡献具有最小的重叠。此外，我们还采用了一种两阶段训练策略，先稳定稀疏表示的学习，然后再将其与残差分支进行耦合。
tldr: 提出DualSAE模块化框架，通过可插拔的残差分支与去相关损失，将稀疏自编码器中的可解释性与重构保真度这两个目标分离，从而学习到语义更纯粹的特征。
en_tdlr: DualSAE, a modular framework that separates interpretability and reconstruction objectives in sparse autoencoders by adding a plug-in Residual Branch with a decorrelation loss and a two-stage training strategy.
